description: Text chunker for RAG — Split a document into embedding-ready chunks that respect paragraph and sentence boundaries. Pass text= or url= (readable page text is extracted first, up to 40,000 characters). Optional: size= target tokens per chunk (50-4000, default 400), overlap= tokens carried into the next chunk (default 12% of size, max half), mode=sentence|paragraph|token, max_chunks= (default 200, max 500). Returns each chunk with text, character offsets, word and token estimates and overlap, plus size stats. Pairs with /v1/embeddings and /v1/rerank. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: text_chunk
